description: Defines the NodeCapabilityRouter class responsible for routing commands to appropriate handlers in the Node capability of the system.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityRouter
classes.description: A class that routes commands to specific handlers based on the command string. It maintains a dictionary of handlers and executes them asynchronously.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a BridgeInvokeRequest by dispatching it to the appropriate handler. Throws an error if no handler is found.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the router with a dictionary of command handlers.
